verdict.rationale: Vanta's core value proposition is automated, continuous evidence collection via integrations (AWS, Okta, GitHub, etc.) replacing manual screenshots/CSVs, backed by docs across multiple framework pages (SOC2, HIPAA, ISO27001, GDPR, PCI) describing automatic pulling of proof and continuous monitoring, plus an API/webhooks for programmatic, timestamped evidence artifacts. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scheduling cadence and artifact timestamping mechanics beyond vendor marketing copy.
